notes: This skill is user-invoked only, so trigger tuning does not apply. Evaluate output quality: findings must be specific, ranked, and free of invented replacement content. No run may modify Linear.

evals.prompt: /reviewing-linear the labels on the Engineering team
evals.expected_output: A ranked findings list identifying duplicate and unused labels, proposing merges, deletions, and archives, without proposing a replacement taxonomy.
assertions: Duplicate pairs such as Bug and type:bug are identified as duplicates and a merge is proposed
Labels applied to no issues are identified, with a proposal to delete or archive
The response distinguishes archiving from deleting and says when each applies
It does not propose a new label scheme to replace the existing one
Each surviving label is justified by naming a view or automation, or flagged as unjustified

evals.prompt: /reviewing-linear the Billing platform foundations project. The plan changed a few weeks ago and I don't think the issues reflect it.
evals.expected_output: Findings covering stale descriptions, misplaced implementation detail, and structural noise, ranked by consequence, each with a concrete fix and a destination for anything removed.
assertions: Findings are ranked, with wrong-object and stale findings above cosmetic ones
Each finding names the object by identifier and states a concrete fix
Implementation detail identified for removal is given a destination such as a pull request, GitHub issue, ADR, or comment
Where a description is thin, the finding says what is missing rather than supplying invented content
Trivial findings of the same kind are grouped rather than listed one by one
Passes that found nothing are reported as clean

evals.prompt: /reviewing-linear check whether our milestones are any good
evals.expected_output: A verdict per milestone using the can-this-be-true test, with renames proposed for those that name teams, layers, or phases, and confirmation of the ones that already name states.
assertions: Each milestone is judged by whether its name can become true
Milestones that already name states are confirmed as good rather than rewritten
Proposed renames are states that can become true, not phases or disciplines
A milestone that cannot be renamed because it encodes no outcome is flagged as such rather than given an invented outcome
